To minimize \(p+q\) for primes \(p,q\) with \(pq \ge 18\):

- If sum \(<10\), possible prime pairs have products:
  \[
  (2,2)=4,\ (2,3)=6,\ (2,5)=10,\ (2,7)=14,\ (3,3)=9,\ (3,5)=15
  \]
  all \(<18\).
- \(p=3,q=7\) gives \(pq=21\ge 18\), with \(p+q=10\).

Thus the minimum total is
\[
5+7+3+7=22.
\]

\[
\boxed{22}
\]
